desc.en: Mobile app hosting platform. The free plan includes five apps, 50 monthly downloads, and a maximum file size of 100 MB.
desc.zh: 移动应用托管平台。免费套餐包含五个应用、每月 50 次下载，最大文件大小为 100 MB。

desc.en: Deploy iOS & Android apps directly to devices. Free plan: app uploads, password-protected links, 1-day expiration, ten installations.
desc.zh: 将 iOS 和 Android 应用直接部署到设备。免费套餐：应用上传、密码保护链接、1 天有效期、十次安装。

desc.en: Distribute mobile apps for testing. The free plan includes one app project, three app versions, 500 MB storage, and 100 app installations per month.
desc.zh: 分发移动应用用于测试。免费套餐包含一个应用项目、三个应用版本、500 MB 存储空间，以及每月 100 次应用安装。

desc.en: Distribute iOS & Android apps over the air. Free plan: unlimited uploads, private links, 2-day expiration for guests, 60 days for registered users.
desc.zh: 通过空中下载分发 iOS 和 Android 应用。免费套餐：上传次数不限、私密链接、访客链接 2 天有效期，注册用户 60 天。

desc.en: iOS & Android beta apps distribution service offers completely free services with unlimited downloads, high-speed downloads, and unlimited uploads.
desc.zh: iOS 和 Android Beta 应用分发服务，提供完全免费的服务，下载次数不限、高速下载、上传次数不限。

desc.en: Manage and distribute Android, iOS and Desktop apps. Useful for tester or self distribution. Try it for free with 2 apps, 1 org, 100 MB storage with unlimited downloads, or self-hosted your self.
desc.zh: 管理和分发 Android、iOS 及桌面应用，适合测试人员或自行分发。可免费试用：2 个应用、1 个组织、100 MB 存储，下载次数不限；也可自行自托管。
